nodes.label: DocumentsToStructuredData Module
nodes.rationale: End-to-end pipeline: parse documents (PDF/images/DOCX) with selectable parser then extract structured data. Returns PipelineResult with parsed_documents, extracted_fields, schema, requirements.

nodes.label: RAGWorkflow Module
nodes.rationale: End-to-end RAG workflow: vision parser -> embedder -> vector store -> retriever -> answer generator. Backed by Chroma, supports re-ranked retrieval, citations, conversation history.

nodes.label: GAIK Toolkit Overview Page
nodes.rationale: Main landing page. Covers knowledge processes (capture, access, synthesis), layer-based architecture, roadmap, consortium, access channels.

nodes.label: Knowledge Capture Process
nodes.rationale: Extract needed information from business documents, videos, voice recordings, emails, meeting recordings.

nodes.label: Knowledge Access Process
nodes.rationale: Intelligent access to organizational knowledge: document repositories, databases, wikis, CRMs.

nodes.label: Knowledge Synthesis Process
nodes.rationale: Automatic generation of business reports, sales proposals, marketing materials, project proposals.

nodes.label: Requirements Layer
nodes.rationale: Requirements capture and specification templates: requirement templates, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional/non-functional frameworks. Under development.

nodes.label: Security and Compliance Layer
nodes.rationale: Security guidelines, compliance checks, audit trails, data privacy frameworks, risk assessment templates. Under development.

nodes.label: Strategy Layer
nodes.rationale: Helps organizations make informed decisions about GenAI: use case selection, adoption readiness assessment, business value evaluation.

nodes.label: Value Evaluation Framework
nodes.rationale: Evaluates informational, economic, operational, and experiential value dimensions of GenAI implementations.

nodes.label: AICapDev (AI Implementation Capability Assessment)
nodes.rationale: Identifies gaps in AI readiness across data, skills, governance, technology, use case management and defines capability development roadmaps.

nodes.label: GenAI Success Canvas
nodes.rationale: Helps structure GenAI implementation process. Aligns strategic goals, use cases, required capabilities, and expected outcomes.

nodes.label: Evaluation Suite (ExtractionEvaluator, RAGEvaluator, BatchEvaluationRunner)
nodes.rationale: gaik.software_components.evaluators. ExtractionEvaluator computes Precision/Recall/F1 and hallucination rate; RAGEvaluator provides RAGAS-style metrics via LLMJudge; BatchEvaluationRunner applies pipeline callables to datasets.

nodes.label: ExtractionEvaluator
nodes.rationale: Computes field-level Precision/Recall/F1 and hallucination rate. Supports exact and semantic match modes.

nodes.label: RAGEvaluator
nodes.rationale: RAGAS-style metrics: faithfulness, answer_relevance, context_precision, context_recall. Each graded via LLMJudge on 1-5 Likert scale.

nodes.label: BatchEvaluationRunner
nodes.rationale: Generic runner applying pipeline callable to dataset, collecting outputs. on_error='skip' records exceptions instead of re-raising.

nodes.label: EvaluationDataset
nodes.rationale: Dataset container loadable from JSONL, CSV, or list. EvaluationItem holds input, expected, context, metadata.

nodes.label: FinnishTextProcessor (Finnish RAG)
nodes.rationale: Lemmatizes Finnish text and optionally splits compound words. Plugs into PgVectorStore via text_processor arg for hybrid FTS+vector search. Backends: voikko, spacy, uralic, simple.

nodes.label: Multi-Provider LLM Client
nodes.rationale: gaik.software_components.llm package (since gaik>=0.3.21). Single config shape for OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google. ProviderClient protocol: chat, chat_parsed, chat_stream, embed.

nodes.label: ProviderClient Protocol
nodes.rationale: Stable interface implemented by all LLM adapters: chat(), chat_parsed(), chat_stream(), embed(). Anthropic raises NotImplementedError for embed().

nodes.label: No-Code Assets
nodes.rationale: Fastest way to deploy GenAI capability without writing code. Two types: Prompt Templates (single prompts) and Agent Skills (fully packaged deployable folders).

nodes.label: Prompt Templates
nodes.rationale: Available packs: construction diary creation, incident report writing, purchase-order processing.

nodes.label: Agent Skills
nodes.rationale: Fully packaged skill folders including prompts, sample data, setup scripts, workflow artifacts. Packs: construction diary, incident report, purchase-order processing, report writing.

nodes.label: Software Components Documentation
nodes.rationale: Core building blocks: Transcriber, Document Parser, Extractor, Vision Extractor, Document Classifier, Validator (LLM-as-Judge), RAG Components.

nodes.label: Transcriber Component
nodes.rationale: OpenAI Whisper-based speech-to-text with optional GPT enhancement. Automatic chunking for long recordings.

nodes.label: Document Parser Component
nodes.rationale: Converts PDF/DOCX to clean markdown. Vision-based (GPT) and local (PyMuPDF, Docling) strategies. Preserves tables, headings, structure.

nodes.label: Extractor Component
nodes.rationale: Natural language requirements -> Requirement Parser -> Schema Generator -> Data Extractor. Type-safe Pydantic validation. Schema persistence.

nodes.label: Vision Extractor Component
nodes.rationale: PDFs/images directly to structured data in single LLM call. Multi-document support, multi-provider (OpenAI/Azure, Anthropic, Google), optional per-field confidence scores.

nodes.label: Document Classifier Component
nodes.rationale: LLM-based zero-shot classification with user-defined classes in plain language. Returns predicted class and confidence score.

nodes.label: LLM-as-Judge Validator
nodes.rationale: Second-pass LLM over extractor output. Returns per-field ok/suspect/wrong flags with reasons and suggested values. Recommended model: gemini-3-flash-preview (F1=1.000 at $0.004/PO).

nodes.label: RAG Components Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Five composable blocks: RAG Parser, Embedder, Vector Store (Chroma or PgVector), Retriever (optional reranking), Answer Generator (citations). Two backends: ChromaDB and PostgreSQL+pgvector.

nodes.label: Software Modules Documentation
nodes.rationale: Production-ready end-to-end pipelines: AudioToStructuredData, DocumentToStructuredData, RAGWorkflow.

nodes.label: Audio-to-Structured-Data Module
nodes.rationale: Combines Transcriber and Extractor. Returns raw transcript, enhanced transcript, structured fields, reusable schema.

nodes.label: Document-to-Structured-Data Module
nodes.rationale: Combines Document Parser and Extractor. Returns parsed markdown, structured fields, reusable schema.

nodes.label: RAG-Workflow Module
nodes.rationale: Combines all 5 RAG components: two phases (indexing and query). Persistent vector store, conversation history, streaming, citations.

nodes.label: Evaluation Methods Index
nodes.rationale: Overview of GAIK evaluation methods: transcription evaluation, extraction evaluation, LLM-as-Judge, LLM-Judge Prompt Benchmark, RAG evaluation (coming soon), report writing eval (coming soon).

nodes.label: Extraction Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Field-level accuracy: exact fields (95% threshold) and semantic fields (80% threshold). Metrics: overall matching rate, true/false positives, false negatives, field-wise accuracy.

nodes.label: LLM-Judge Prompt Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Empirical comparison of naive 1-10 vs research-backed Likert+CoT+bias-mitigation prompt on JudgeBench (N=50). Research prompt: +2% accuracy, -4% position-bias flips, +35% cost, +19% latency.

nodes.label: JudgeBench Dataset
nodes.rationale: 350 challenging response pairs with ground-truth A>B/B>A labels. MIT licence. arXiv:2410.12784.

nodes.label: LLM-as-Judge Validation
nodes.rationale: LLMJudge: v2 features including integer Likert 1-5, few-shot calibration, LLMJudgePanel (3+ judges majority vote), pairwise A/B with swap_and_average, calibration utility (Pearson r vs humans).

nodes.label: LLMJudgePanel
nodes.rationale: 3+ judges with majority vote aggregation and agreement metric. Severity=mode (ties resolve worst), Score=median Likert.

nodes.label: HuggingFace LLM Judge Cookbook
nodes.rationale: Referenced for ~30% human-correlation gain when using Likert vs continuous scales.

nodes.label: Luvata OC Builder
nodes.rationale: Production system consuming LLMJudge with single judge call and opt-in UI toggle per purchase order.

nodes.label: Justice or Prejudice? Position-Bias Swap Mitigation (OpenReview 2024)

hyperedges.label: GAIK Toolkit Layer-Based Architecture
hyperedges.rationale: The GAIK Toolkit is organized into six layers: Strategy, Requirements, Business, Implementation (Software Components/Modules), Security Compliance, and Guidance. Each layer serves a distinct purpose in the GenAI solution development lifecycle.

hyperedges.label: GAIK Core Knowledge Processes
hyperedges.rationale: The GAIK toolkit focuses on three core knowledge processes: capture, access, and synthesis. All components and use cases map to these processes.

hyperedges.label: LLMJudge v2 Feature Set
hyperedges.rationale: LLMJudge v2 implements research-backed features: integer Likert 1-5 scoring (from HF cookbook), panel/jury aggregation (cross-model bias averaging), pairwise comparison with swap-and-average position-bias mitigation (Justice or Prejudice), and calibration against human labels.
